UNIPARTS.priority: First source-review priority among the six reviewed matches
UNIPARTS.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue ~₹347cr (+27%), PAT ~₹57cr (+64%), operating cash ~₹44cr; net cash ~₹190cr. Management reports >₹225cr trailing new business wins. Current quantitative TTM growth and P/E also match the screen.
UNIPARTS.risks: OEM/agricultural/construction cycles, tariff effects, 139 working-capital days and whether new business wins convert to shipped recurring revenue.
UNIPARTS.next_evidence: Next-quarter order conversion, operating cash generation, stable working-capital days and preservation of net cash.

KERNEX.thesis: Real Kavach exposure with major railway awards, including the company-disclosed ₹2041.4cr CLW order; quantitative revenue/PAT growth is very strong.
KERNEX.risks: FY26 consolidated operating cash flow approximately −₹99.74cr and borrowings ~₹162.11cr in the annual report. Government concentration, collections, execution and certification obligations matter more than backlog size alone.
KERNEX.next_evidence: Collection of receivables, cash generation from deliveries, declining funding strain, and completion of the stated RDSO/ISA milestones.

GOLDIAM.priority: Conditional watch: normalize earnings and reconcile price adjustment
GOLDIAM.thesis: Lab-grown diamond business, >₹225cr June order book and ~₹456.7cr reported cash/investments. Company reports a growing domestic ORIGEM footprint.
GOLDIAM.risks: Q1 FY27 other income includes a tariff refund; reported EBITDA is not fully recurring. July 1:3 bonus requires 4/3 shares versus the June capital base. The historical-price adjustment is unreconciled, so the trend flag needs verification. US demand/tariffs and retail expansion costs remain material.
GOLDIAM.next_evidence: Recurring margins and PAT excluding refund effects, cash conversion, sell-through of customer-held inventory, and reconciled bonus-adjusted price history.

RPTECH.thesis: Q1 FY27 presentation reports revenue ~₹5102cr and PAT ~₹105cr; new enterprise demand and operating leverage support the growth case.
RPTECH.risks: Distribution margins are thin. Presentation shows FY26 operating cash flow −₹299.2cr despite PAT ~₹282.3cr. Working capital and financing can absorb reported profit.
RPTECH.next_evidence: Positive operating cash over a full reporting period, inventory/receivable discipline, and profit growth persisting after product-price increases normalise.

SOTL.risks: September presentation explicitly attributes part of quarter performance to inventory gains; reported growth/P/E can overstate durable earnings power.
SOTL.next_evidence: Volume and unit-margin growth excluding inventory holding gains.

VADILALIND.risks: Latest governance updates lacked archived text in the inspected source selection; no source-verified qualitative ranking is claimed.
VADILALIND.next_evidence: Review annual cash flow, governance updates and seasonally comparable operating performance.
